sources.title: Carrier completes sale of NORESCO
sources.excerpt: PALM BEACH GARDENS, Fla., Aug. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Carrier Global Corporation (NYSE: CARR) today announced it has completed the sale of its NORESCO business to OPTERRA Energy Services, a subsidiary of LS Power. News provided by Carrier Global Corporation; this is an issuer-origin release, not independent PR Newswire reporting. Sale price is not disclosed in the observed release.
